What happened to the pig that went to market - and to the steelmakers of Millom?
							| Historical Metallurgy
text:
What happened to the pig that went to market - and to the steelmakers of Millom? | Historical Metallurgy 

 

 Published January 28, 2022 

Robson Davis

 Rheged, 50 Brynfield Road, Langland, Swansea SA3 4SX. 

## Abstract

Part 1 of this paper traces the causes of the demise of merchant pig iron praduction in Britain. Part 2 records features of the ironworks at The Millom Hematite Ore and Iron Co Ltd in Cumberland, including the Millspray pilot steelplant. Part 3 deals with the controversial dispute between the Company and the Iron and Steel Board (ISB) who opposed Millom's plan to make steel.
